name: Aurevia Practice OS — Monday Executive Telemetry Dispatch

parameters.content:
## Monday Executive Revenue & Health Dispatch
Runs automatically every Monday at 08:00 AM.
1. Gathers 7-day performance metrics across all configured clinics.
2. Computes revenue recovered, missed call conversions, open handoffs.
3. Formats executive HTML briefing.
4. Dispatches email to clinic owner/director.
